
[yellow bold]-- DEPRECATION -- adv_iot.volt:1[/yellow bold]

Move `chip esp32` to volt.toml: chip = "esp32"

 [dim]1 |[/dim] chip esp32
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]     ^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: The chip declaration will move to volt.toml in a future version.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- CONCURRENCY -- adv_iot.volt:11[/yellow bold]

Variable `motor_isr_count` is shared between motor_control (critical) and stats. Each read and write is atomic in the generated C.

 [dim]10 |[/dim] var heartbeat_count: int = 0
 [dim]11 |[/dim] var motor_isr_count: int = 0
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: An update spread over several statements can still interleave; keep it in one statement or use a channel.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- adv_iot.volt:57[/yellow bold]

`wifi.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]56 |[/dim] setup {
 [dim]57 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("TestNetwork", "TestPassword")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- UNHANDLED FAILURE -- adv_iot.volt:58[/yellow bold]

`mqtt.connect` has no fallback if it fails.

 [dim]57 |[/dim]     wifi.connect("TestNetwork", "TestPassword")
 [dim]58 |[/dim]     mqtt.connect("mqtt://broker.local")
 [dim]   |[/dim] [yellow]    ^^^^[/yellow]

[cyan]Hint: Without one the program carries on offline. Add `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.[/cyan]
